SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'mem_avail_real' AND device_name LIKE 'sw-%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name = 'mem_avail_real' AND device_name LIKE 'ap-%' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS time, device_name, metric_value,
    LAG(metric_value) OVER (PARTITION BY device_name ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_value,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY device_name ORDER BY timestamp))) AS dt
  FROM snmp_metrics
  WHERE metric_name LIKE 'if_in_octets%'
    AND device_name IN ('usw-pro-24', 'usw-flex-mini')
    AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT time, device_name AS metric,
  CASE WHEN dt > 0 AND metric_value >= prev_value 
    THEN ROUND((metric_value - prev_value) / dt)
    ELSE 0 END AS value
FROM ordered
WHERE prev_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time
